name: luminous-quartz-sheen12-rest-damage
notes: Engine bug (flagged, not fixed): customDQHandlers["40lgjj1yS3:0:ActivateAbility-1"] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php ~27051) calls RemoveCounters($player, $champMZ, ...) but never assigns $champMZ in that handler -- a genuine 'Undefined variable $champMZ' PHP warning fires and the preparation-counter cost is silently never paid, even though the damage still resolves correctly. This fixture documents the card's actual observed behavior. GeneratedMacroCode.php is a generated/gitignored file, so the real fix belongs in the card-ability source data, not a hand-edit.

rulesClauses: [Sheen 12+] REST, Remove a preparation counter from your champion: As a Spell, deal 1+X damage to target unit, where X is the amount of sheen counters on it.
